venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Super busy night that did not slow down after 5pm until last call. Lots of large parties — one group with close to 30 guests (leaving and joining). Net (excl events) $9,470.30 vs target $5,848.50 (+61.9%). Including events $19,190.30 (+228.1%). Segments: DC/AM $749.53 (great event vibes; only one IRD and 0 cocktails; Maggie huge help; ice teas looking good — thanks Felix), D&C PM $8,720.77. Food $2,276.80 / Food incl events $11,216.80. Comps $296.79 / 3.13%. 224 guests. **Event**: Day 2 of Contractors Coalition — 60 guests 7am–5pm in all spaces. Josh did a big breakfast & lunch spread. Group filmed in the Garden and ran presentations in Vauxhall. Event food $8,940, net event sales $9,720. Looking forward to Day 3. AM MOD: Maggie & Lucas. PM MOD: Carey. **Maintenance**: printer cheat-code request. Highlight: Frank & family in for a chunk of the evening; Becky Rose celebrating her trip to World Class; Annie by for an oyster surprise.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Final cold day of the year
venues.narrative: Essentially on plan — missed target by just −3.1% ($4,813 vs $4,968). Built to a chill flow in first turn — beautiful contrast between point (patrons ripping drinks faster than physically possible) and tables (most >2 groups composed of one enthusiast surrounded by reluctant pedestrian friends). Salon Sundays brings out the midtops. Beautiful finisher: duo sat at 12:30, two rounds, Dante coursed it out beautifully. Best conversation: served several concertgoers of Hüsker Dü alumnus Sugar — Gen X music chat. 5 investor cocktails, 9 solos, 4 large parties. Top sellers: Revenant, Material Control, Buckhorn Exchange/Year of the Trees (tie). Food $629, Bev $4,185. Comps $324.04 (majority a press thing for some influencers, then member discounts; ~$90 of DNL/gift items, low actually). 131 guests / $37 GCA. Door: room stayed steadily full right off the bat; smooth turns 7–8:30 hours kept energy up; never accumulated waitlist; able to plug-and-play walk-ins, reservations, joiners; full bar at last call (walk-in 5 for the win). 0 no-shows. Glassware: 1 martini, 1 Pilsner, 1 DOF, 1 N&N, 4 SOFs. Menu count 18. MOD: Seth & Alejandro. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: Sunday Fun Day — beat target by +14.6% ($4,747 vs $4,143). Smooth evening with lots of lovely people. Met a couple interested in a cocktail class with Raven-Pokemon theme requested. Mitchell and his girlfriend came in (Julian got to meet her too). Room filled quickly during the first hour, then ups and downs with pacing — never overwhelming or too slow. Quite a few large parties. Never had to form a waitlist. Plenty of time to catch up on admin and small side projects. Mexican bolero, bossa nova and afro beats. Marquee $4,747 / Marquee food $591. Total food $591. Comps $117.14 (Jeffrey, Mitchell + Anna, Concha, double birthdays, Dennis). 152 guests / $31.23 GCA. **Kitchen**: Gigi got the tuna crudo down (per Chef). **Maintenance**: women's faucet is loose. MOD: Gigi & Chef Sel. Entered by Gigi. Highlight: watching the whole room at the peak of service under candlelight, laughing, enjoying drinks and good company.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: Missed target by −13.8% ($6,896 vs $8,000). MB Morning $1,715 / 63g (slow but steady, strong street traffic and guests enjoying sunny weather after rainy weekend; pickup around 11am for a couple hours then tapered until happy hour; cuts made accordingly, downtime used for ABK/restocking). MB Evening $3,353 / 85g (pretty quiet Sunday — bar half full all shift, never more than 6 tables at a single time; all guests gone by 11:15; Tanner's first day of SA training). Sun Club $1,047 (busy throughout — strong walk-in traffic, many guests up to the rooftop; great weather; Brigid did a thorough clean of leaves/debris before opening; 5pm pop had her hustling 20 min, then chill close). Hot Eye $767 (very mellow night — normal bar crawl then empty until ~10; mostly filled with regulars and hotel guests; one guest said Elizabeth made the best pisco sour outside of Peru). Food $2,350. Comps $250. AM MOD: Gabby & Lex. PM MOD: Justin & Shannon. Entered by Sam B. Highlight: a local ghost tour guide (friend of Catie's family) in for a dinner date; Justin's brother visiting from out of town.
